🤝 談「社會處方」與社區連結員】
其實，很多時候基層朋友面對的困境，從來不只是以一個「病痛」就解釋一切，背後涉及如何應付生活壓力、孤獨感、住屋與經濟問題等等健康的社會決定因素。醫護行者在社區工作多年，我們深切體會到，比起單純的轉介，他們需要的，是同行與陪伴，把零散的支援真正串聯起來。

最近，醫護行者創辦人暨執行董事范寧醫生與高級社區營養師 Ruby 在《南華早報》撰文，與大家分享我們對香港基層醫療與「社會處方（Social Prescribing）」的觀察與思考。

文章想帶出的核心訊息十分清晰：社會處方絕不只是「轉介你去參加活動」這麼簡單，而是由專業人員先了解一個人的整體需要，再由受訓的「社區連結員（Link Worker）」陪伴與同行，一起訂立目標、尋找合適的社區資源建立行動方案、持續跟進，讓支援真正融入生活。

💡 文章重點一覽
- 看見「病」以外的需要：健康與住屋、經濟、照顧壓力、孤獨感及健康素養息息相關。
- 善用現有社區資源：香港其實不缺資源，最重要的是幫居民找到路、找到人幫忙。
- 社區連結員的溫度陪伴，而非單次轉介﹕從了解需要、訂立目標到持續跟進，提升動機與動力，一路同行。
- 打破服務之間的界線：讓醫療、社福與社區力量跨界協作，減少大家在不同服務之間四處奔波。

透過這篇文章，我們邀請大家一起想像，一個真正以人為本、有溫度的健康支援系統，究竟會是什麼模樣？

🤝 談「社會處方」與社區連結員】
其實，很多時候基層朋友面對的困境，從來不只是以一個「病痛」就解釋一切，背後涉及如何應付生活壓力、孤獨感、住屋與經濟問題等等健康的社會決定因素。醫護行者在社區工作多年，我們深切體會到，比起單純的轉介，他們需要的，是同行與陪伴，把零散的支援真正串聯起來。

最近，醫護行者創辦人暨執行董事范寧醫生與高級社區營養師 Ruby 在《南華早報》撰文，與大家分享我們對香港基層醫療與「社會處方（Social Prescribing）」的觀察與思考。

文章想帶出的核心訊息十分清晰：社會處方絕不只是「轉介你去參加活動」這麼簡單，而是由專業人員先了解一個人的整體需要，再由受訓的「社區連結員（Link Worker）」陪伴與同行，一起訂立目標、尋找合適的社區資源建立行動方案、持續跟進，讓支援真正融入生活。

💡 文章重點一覽
- 看見「病」以外的需要：健康與住屋、經濟、照顧壓力、孤獨感及健康素養息息相關。
- 善用現有社區資源：香港其實不缺資源，最重要的是幫居民找到路、找到人幫忙。
- 社區連結員的溫度陪伴，而非單次轉介﹕從了解需要、訂立目標到持續跟進，提升動機與動力，一路同行。
- 打破服務之間的界線：讓醫療、社福與社區力量跨界協作，減少大家在不同服務之間四處奔波。

透過這篇文章，我們邀請大家一起想像，一個真正以人為本、有溫度的健康支援系統，究竟會是什麼模樣？

Einstein’s Theory Revealed That Gravity Is More Than a Force
According to Einstein’s general theory of relativity, gravity is not simply an invisible force pulling objects through space. Instead, mass and energy curve the four-dimensional structure of spacetime, while freely moving objects follow the resulting paths, known as geodesics.

⸻

☀️ The Sun, for example, creates a curvature in spacetime around it. Earth follows a curved path through this spacetime, producing the orbit we observe. From this perspective, Earth is not simply being pulled along a straight path toward the Sun.

⸻

💡 General relativity also explains phenomena that Newton’s description of gravity cannot fully account for, including the bending of light around massive objects. This effect, known as gravitational lensing, allows astronomers to observe how massive objects distort the paths of light traveling through space.

🕳️ The effects become even more extreme near objects such as black holes, where spacetime is curved so intensely that the paths of light can be dramatically altered.

🌌 Einstein’s theory transformed our understanding of gravity—from a force acting through space into a consequence of the geometry of spacetime itself.

Einstein’s Theory Revealed That Gravity Is More Than a Force
According to Einstein’s general theory of relativity, gravity is not simply an invisible force pulling objects through space. Instead, mass and energy curve the four-dimensional structure of spacetime, while freely moving objects follow the resulting paths, known as geodesics.

⸻

☀️ The Sun, for example, creates a curvature in spacetime around it. Earth follows a curved path through this spacetime, producing the orbit we observe. From this perspective, Earth is not simply being pulled along a straight path toward the Sun.

⸻

💡 General relativity also explains phenomena that Newton’s description of gravity cannot fully account for, including the bending of light around massive objects. This effect, known as gravitational lensing, allows astronomers to observe how massive objects distort the paths of light traveling through space.

🕳️ The effects become even more extreme near objects such as black holes, where spacetime is curved so intensely that the paths of light can be dramatically altered.

🌌 Einstein’s theory transformed our understanding of gravity—from a force acting through space into a consequence of the geometry of spacetime itself.

Einstein’s Theory Revealed That Gravity Is More Than a Force","post_message_body":{"text":"According to Einstein’s general theory of relativity, gravity is not simply an invisible force pulling objects through space. Instead, mass and energy curve the four-dimensional structure of spacetime, while freely moving objects follow the resulting paths, known as geodesics.

⸻

☀️ The Sun, for example, creates a curvature in spacetime around it. Earth follows a curved path through this spacetime, producing the orbit we observe. From this perspective, Earth is not simply being pulled along a straight path toward the Sun.

⸻

💡 General relativity also explains phenomena that Newton’s description of gravity cannot fully account for, including the bending of light around massive objects. This effect, known as gravitational lensing, allows astronomers to observe how massive objects distort the paths of light traveling through space.

🕳️ The effects become even more extreme near objects such as black holes, where spacetime is curved so intensely that the paths of light can be dramatically altered.

🌌 Einstein’s theory transformed our understanding of gravity—from a force acting through space into a consequence of the geometry of spacetime itself.

Einstein’s Theory Revealed That Gravity Is More Than a Force
According to Einstein’s general theory of relativity, gravity is not simply an invisible force pulling objects through space. Instead, mass and energy curve the four-dimensional structure of spacetime, while freely moving objects follow the resulting paths, known as geodesics.

⸻

☀️ The Sun, for example, creates a curvature in spacetime around it. Earth follows a curved path through this spacetime, producing the orbit we observe. From this perspective, Earth is not simply being pulled along a straight path toward the Sun.

⸻

💡 General relativity also explains phenomena that Newton’s description of gravity cannot fully account for, including the bending of light around massive objects. This effect, known as gravitational lensing, allows astronomers to observe how massive objects distort the paths of light traveling through space.

🕳️ The effects become even more extreme near objects such as black holes, where spacetime is curved so intensely that the paths of light can be dramatically altered.

🌌 Einstein’s theory transformed our understanding of gravity—from a force acting through space into a consequence of the geometry of spacetime itself.

Einstein’s Theory Revealed That Gravity Is More Than a Force
According to Einstein’s general theory of relativity, gravity is not simply an invisible force pulling objects through space. Instead, mass and energy curve the four-dimensional structure of spacetime, while freely moving objects follow the resulting paths, known as geodesics.

⸻

☀️ The Sun, for example, creates a curvature in spacetime around it. Earth follows a curved path through this spacetime, producing the orbit we observe. From this perspective, Earth is not simply being pulled along a straight path toward the Sun.

⸻

💡 General relativity also explains phenomena that Newton’s description of gravity cannot fully account for, including the bending of light around massive objects. This effect, known as gravitational lensing, allows astronomers to observe how massive objects distort the paths of light traveling through space.

🕳️ The effects become even more extreme near objects such as black holes, where spacetime is curved so intensely that the paths of light can be dramatically altered.

🌌 Einstein’s theory transformed our understanding of gravity—from a force acting through space into a consequence of the geometry of spacetime itself.

Einstein’s Theory Revealed That Gravity Is More Than a Force","post_message_body":{"text":"According to Einstein’s general theory of relativity, gravity is not simply an invisible force pulling objects through space. Instead, mass and energy curve the four-dimensional structure of spacetime, while freely moving objects follow the resulting paths, known as geodesics.

⸻

☀️ The Sun, for example, creates a curvature in spacetime around it. Earth follows a curved path through this spacetime, producing the orbit we observe. From this perspective, Earth is not simply being pulled along a straight path toward the Sun.

⸻

💡 General relativity also explains phenomena that Newton’s description of gravity cannot fully account for, including the bending of light around massive objects. This effect, known as gravitational lensing, allows astronomers to observe how massive objects distort the paths of light traveling through space.

🕳️ The effects become even more extreme near objects such as black holes, where spacetime is curved so intensely that the paths of light can be dramatically altered.

🌌 Einstein’s theory transformed our understanding of gravity—from a force acting through space into a consequence of the geometry of spacetime itself.
